profiles: mirror validate: sync/async TCP or TLS, direct or registry-discovered
mirror trace-gen: sync/async TCP or TLS, direct/discovered; inline or explicit pinned shared transfer
Shell.Client and Shell.TraceCapture helpers supporting those commands

rules.note: Outbound compact JSON+LF is correct. TCP/TLS receivers accept EOF/error buffered payload without LF as a complete message; mandatory receive framing gap.

Shared65535-byteUTF8 validation; TCP/TLS cap each raw prefix before decoding; max scratch65536 means bounded two-chunk temporary. validate/trace-gen registration preflight checks exact compact final bytes.
Codec.decodeMirror dispatches proto_step; additive outer fields ignored; TraceCapture separately retains raw ITF metadata.
Validation sends register_validate/async; TraceCapture sends register_trace_gen/async before awaiting its accepted job.

Validation exits terminally, but async trace capture sends cancel_job after any await error including received protocol_error. Shared async registration-attempt C5 wording discrepancy remains separate.

One connection per CLI process; normal EOF/error becomes infrastructure failure and process exit closes descriptors. Transport record has no public explicitclose capability; reusable helpers are not advertised as independent long-lived SDK.

No heartbeat or protocol liveness assumption. TLS client sets SO_RCVTIMEO5000 before handshake and leaves it set; shim retries WANT_READ/WANT_WRITE. Exact silent-established-peer timing behavior not freshly checked.
Built-in validate/trace-gen clients do not implement SUT replay. tools/CounterSpec is a test client, not production CLI replay.
No report_state/StateComputer flow in these built-in CLI commands.
No replay mismatch-producing flow advertised; unexpected reply returns failure, never waits for all_steps_done.
No SUT report-state encoder; captured ITF is parsed/preserved by trace capture.
numTraces and bound are requested generation controls; no SUT replay step counts assumed.
resolveClientSources uses captured parsed SourceUnits and recursive EXTENDS/INSTANCE closure, explicit deps/module identity and source limits. CLI final compact registration preflight obeys65k.
ApalacheConfig uses options and Codec encoder; absent/null Haskell semantics handled server-side. CLI supplies default bound10/invariant empty.
--cinit propagates constInit. Arbitrary specs declaring CONSTANTS require caller to choose valid initializer; CLI cannot infer it.

validate bound is Nat but not locally capped; registration reaches server which rejects outside[1,100] synchronously. Client preflight bound check not required by this rule. trace-gen has separate profile bounds.
Async workflows retain submitting connection until terminal result; not detached submission and no crossconnection facade. Exact accepted job ID carried into waits.
await_job timeout30; pending/running statuses recurse, not treated as errors. Trace capture has explicit maxPolls budget.

Trace capture cancels owned job on failure/budget exhaustion, but overbroad terminal-error cancellation has C5 finding. Validate has no separate cancellation command; CLIexit triggers ownerdisconnect semantics.
Async .validate result uses same Codec.ValidateResult/reportValidate as sync; infraError remains failure and genTraces kind rejected.
Unknown or evicted exits immediately, never retry-looped. Trace capture also errors immediately, though cancellation cleanup sends an unnecessary followup.
No connection pool: one selected transport; register_error returns infrastructure failure. No hidden retry of full queue.
Only one owned job polled per invocation; every status/result correlation checked, no assumption across jobs/connections.
OpenSSL min=maxTLS1.3; client context loads cert/key and verifies CA; no-certificate server handshakes fail.
X509_VERIFY_PARAM name or IP identity with NEVER_CHECK_SUBJECT prevents CN fallback.
PeerSHA256 checked case-insensitively before returning usable Transport; CLI explicit pin overrides registry advertised pin.
POSIX key check only rejects group/other access; accepts0400,0700 and special ownerbits, while guide says exactly0600. Windows ACL exception explicit.

Built-in validate/trace-gen clients send no negotiation extension; guide explicitly limits modelInterface to register/register_traces. Server/compiler MI support does not imply a negotiating validation client.
No built-in CLI shared Gate evaluator advertised for validate/trace-gen/discovery. Gate support in optional language facades is reviewed separately.

findings.trigger: After async job_accepted, await_job receives protocol_error. awaitTraceJob returns .error; run unconditionally invokes cancelOwned.
findings.impact: Client writes cancel_job on a flow declared unusable by guide section10. This can add writes/errors after terminal protocol failure and obscures correct ownership cleanup. This is distinct from shared queue-full/register-attempt ambiguity.
findings.fix: Keep a typed failure/connection-usability distinction and issue cancellation only for locally exhausted polling/caller cancellation while the connection is healthy; terminal protocol errors return directly.

findings.trigger: Peer sends a syntactically complete response JSON without finalLF then closes (or read errors).
findings.impact: TCP/TLS transport treats incomplete frame as a complete response, so validation/trace-gen may accept a truncated protocol exchange as successful. Bounded payload/UTF8 checks still apply.
findings.fix: Reject nonempty buffered EOF/error without LF; retain clean EOF and validLF normal path. Add focused rawsocket transport regression and CLI completeJSON-withoutLF negative fixture.

findings.trigger: Readable valid client private key has POSIX0400/0700 or special bits with no group/other access.
findings.impact: Built-in mTLS client accepts permissions outside the literal0600 contract. This does not establish a confidentiality exposure;400 is narrower access.
findings.fix: Either enforce exactmode&07777==0600 consistently or explicitly revise the guide if owner-only modes are intended; do not label broad group/other check as literal0600 enforcement.

testEvidence.cases: scripted async normal, pending/running/timeout, invalid, unknown/cancelled/id errors
options, shared root admission, wrong job correlation and ownedjob cancellation
65535/65536 send size, malformed UTF8, TCP/TLS echo, SAN/IP/wrongpin/clientauth/TLS12; permission test covers640 notexact0400/0700
network requires inlineITF; server paths refused unless explicitshared mapping; no directApalache fallback

limits: Read-only static review of shipped CLI/client helper paths; no local/remote builds/tests, model operations or service calls.
tools/CounterSpec.lean is test scaffolding, not a production full SUT replay SDK.
No current-source runtime acceptance is claimed from test presence or historical server/CLI gates.
TLSclient established socket timeout is retained and shim retries WANT_READ; platform timing behavior needs a targeted remote probe before asserting an idle timeout failure.
CLI process exit owns final descriptor teardown; reusable transport-close API and embedding semantics were not assessed as an independently advertised SDK.
Remote destPath capture uses explicit mapping with pinnedTLS admission; absent that mapping server paths remain receipt data.
